profile.ja: 蟲遁の術を使う対魔忍。特殊なフェロモンを発することによって虫を操り、戦闘から斥候まで幅広い任務に使役する。魔界に住む魔蟲にはフェロモンが効きにくかったが、捕獲し飼育を続ける事で一部を使役する事に成功している。虫に関する豊富な知識を持ち、虫を原料とした毒や薬を作る事も行っている。危険な蟲を多数飼育しているため、街中からは離れた場所に居を構えているらしい。体術においても並みの魔族には負けない程度の腕前を持つが、蟲を扱う忍法は同じ対魔忍からも恐れられることが多く、彼女と組んだ若手が目の前で魔蟲が敵を蹂躙する様を見てトラウマを負うこともある。しかし彼女はその力に自信と誇りを持っているので堂々と振る舞っている。また、蟲に蹂躙される姿を見て喜ぶサディスティックな性質と、享楽主義的な部分から男の噂は絶えないものの、彼女の性癖についていける男がいないためか、決まった相手はいない様子。以前、嫌々ながら新入生歓迎会でチアガール姿を披露した成美だったが、彼女の姿を見た新入生達が皆真面目になったと上層部からは好評だった。そこで正月のイベントでも是非巫女役をして欲しいと依頼されてしまう。成美は拒否したが何度も頭を下げられ、様々な優遇措置や臨時ボーナスまで提示され、渋々受ける事になる。とは言え内心納得出来ていない成美は、凄絶なオーラを放ちつつ「お祓い」と称してたるんだ学生をしばきまわすのだった。
profile.en: Soma Narumi is a Taimanin who uses the insect escape technique. By emitting a special pheromone, she can control insects, using them for a wide range of tasks from combat to scouting. While the pheromone is less effective on demon insects native to the Demon Realm, she has managed to capture and domesticate some, successfully commanding a few. She possesses extensive knowledge of insects and excels at creating poisons and medicines from them; because she keeps many dangerous insects, she lives in a secluded area away from the city. In hand-to-hand combat, she can hold her own against average demons, but her insect-based ninjutsu often frightens fellow Taimanin, and junior partners who team up with her sometimes develop trauma after witnessing demon insects tearing enemies apart. However, she is confident and proud of her abilities, carrying herself with poise. Her sadistic enjoyment of such scenes and hedonistic streak keep rumors about her circulating among men, yet no one seems able to satisfy her particular tastes, and she appears to have no steady partner. Previously, she had reluctantly dressed up as a cheerleader for the new student welcoming event, and although the students were initially intimidated by her, the administration considered it a success. As a result, she was asked to dress up as a shrine maiden for the New Year's event, which she initially refused but eventually accepted after being offered various perks and a bonus.

text.ja: 新年あけましておめでとう……あら、挨拶がないわね。そんな不心得者にはキツいお祓いが必要だから、そこに直りなさい
text.en: Happy New Year... and what's with the lack of greetings? I suppose people like you need a good scolding, so get over here.

text.ja: 私が巫女服を着るなんて、清らかとか乙女なんて言葉とはほど遠すぎて罰も当たらなそうね
text.en: Me, wearing a shrine maiden's outfit? It's a bit too much to ask, considering how far it is from being pure or maidenly.

text.ja: 春先のチア衣装で新入生が真面目になったからと依頼されたんだから、徹底的に厳しくするのをご所望なのでしょう？
text.en: I was asked to discipline the new student because they became serious after wearing the cheerleader outfit for the spring festival, so I suppose you want me to be thorough and strict.

text.ja: ……次はどんな特典を積まれようと、アサギ校長が頭を下げようと絶対にやらないわよ。決・し・て
text.en: ……No matter what privileges are offered, or even if Igawa Asagi herself bows down, I'll never do it. Absolutely not.

text.ja: 気合いを入れるためにも片肌脱ぎは必須でしょう？　袴の裾……？　自分で裾を上げたわよ。こっちの方が格好良いんだから
text.en: To get pumped up, don't you think taking off one sleeve is a must? The hem of my hakama...? I lifted it myself. This way looks better, after all.

text.ja: たるんでいる学生はこの御幣でひとしきりしばき倒せば、“いい子”になるわ。それでもダメならこの蟲が……ね♪
text.en: Students who are slacking off can be disciplined with this sacred paper, and they'll become "good kids." If that doesn't work, then these insects... well, you know♪

text.ja: 新年だから巫女だなんて安直な発想誰がしてるのかしらね……思いついたヤツがやれば良いのよこんなこと
text.en: I wonder who came up with the obvious idea of being a shrine maiden just because it's the new year. If someone thought of it, they can just do it themselves.

text.ja: そもそも新年で浮かれるのが理解出来ないわ。そうねえ、せめて蟲年でもあるのなら考えないでもないけれど……冗談よ
text.en: To be honest, I don't understand why people get excited about the new year. Well, if it were the year of the insect, maybe I could understand... but that's just a joke.

text.ja: ストレス発散するにはチンポを責めて情けなく射精させるに限るわね♪　ほら、早くそのデカチンポおっ勃てなさい！
text.en: The best way to relieve stress is to torment a penis and make it ejaculate pitifully, don't you think?♪ Come on, hurry up and get that big penis hard!

text.ja: ふふふ、胸でしごかれて射精するのが随分と気持ち良さそうだけど、まだよ。勃たなくなるまでズリ犯してあげる
text.en: It looks like you're feeling pretty good with your chest being groped and ejaculating, but not yet. I'll keep violating you until you can't get hard anymore.

text.ja: 私の胸と顔をザーメンまみれにするなんて生意気なチンポじゃない。ふん、またすぐに狂うほどにイかせてあげるわ
text.en: You've got some nerve, trying to cover my face and chest with your semen. Ha! I'll make you cum again, and soon.
